listing.name: Twisted Metal 4 — TwistedMetal1234Recomp (jcoker85)
listing.summary: Experimental project. This is the native TM4 program in the shared kit. Portcove has not confirmed the full game or alternate revisions. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PS1 USA TwistedMetal4 SCUS94560 Rev1 CHD or CUE/BIN; do not reuse TMIII/TM2 source.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the shared Windows launcher and tools/generate.sh setup, selecting tm4 with your own Rev1 disc. Keep both the runtime and disc available during play.

warnings: This is the native TM4 program in the shared kit. Portcove has not confirmed the full game or alternate revisions.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
